name: Seated Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are extended.
Keep your wrists stacked over elbows.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A seated dumbbell shoulder press that builds the delts and triceps.
